role: Later exhibition window scenery; not an NFT, canonical artwork, live feed or simulated observing location.

earth.processing: Unmodified NASA natural-color PNG, including original black background and limb. Pacific-centred view. No generated land/clouds, saturation filter, artificial terminator or added atmospheric halo.
earth.installation: Entrance direction +Z. Camera-relative distant image plane with fixed world orientation; responsive angular size.

stars.selection: Exclude Sun, retain visual magnitude <= 3.0; copy catalog ID, right ascension, declination and magnitude. J2000 catalog positions, no current-date precession.
stars.orientation: Exit faces RA 6h, Dec 0 degrees; fixed celestial arrangement, not a claimed Earth-based local sky.
stars.appearance: Black background; small neutral star points weighted by catalog magnitude, no twinkling, flares, nebulae or long-exposure Milky Way. Curated visibility for a lit gallery, not a model of fully dark-adapted vision.
stars.renderingLicense: Star subset and its rendered arrangement: CC BY-SA 4.0; application code is separate.

lighting: Exit point fill reduced 18 to 6; invitation ring emissive baseline 2.1 to 0.65; floor and labels remain readable.
